value.rationale: The theorem replaces qualitative compactness for a newly studied tree-Hardy composition setting by complete exact approximation numbers and their level multiplicities. A natural two-integer depth family yields nontrivial log-periodic critical weak-ideal behavior, and unweighted symbols realize every positive critical exponent. This provides quantitative finite-rank approximation geometry and sharp ideal thresholds rather than a routine isolated finite computation.
